features.name: Document Chunking
features.description: IndexingService splits documents into ~500 char chunks at paragraph boundaries
features.evidence: Implemented complete chunking pipeline: IndexingService.chunkDocument() splits content on paragraph boundaries (~500 chars), stores chunks in chunks/<doc-id>.json, updates document status to 'indexed', and tracks chunk count in metadata. Integration test verified: 1786-char document generated 5 chunks (avg 356 chars), all chunks have required properties (id, documentId, content, index, metadata with charCount/wordCount), indexes are sequential. UI includes 'Index Document' button and 'Show Chunks' viewer in DocumentDetail.

features.name: Metadata Extraction
features.description: On import, extract word count, line count, and file type metadata from documents
features.evidence: Implemented metadata extraction in DocumentService.importDocument(): added wordCount (split content by whitespace), lineCount (split by newlines), and fileType (extract extension) to Document interface. Updated DocumentDetail component to display these fields. Integration test verified: 138-byte .txt file correctly extracted 24 words, 6 lines, and 'txt' type; .md file correctly identified as 'md' type. All tests passed.

features.name: Indexing Status in StatusBar
features.description: StatusBar shows indexing progress with document counts and status indicator
features.evidence: Implemented indexing status display in StatusBar: Added 'indexedCount' field to AppStatus interface; updated StatusBar to show 'X of Y indexed' format; fixed status refresh flow by adding onIndexed callback to DocumentDetail that triggers App.refreshDocuments() after indexing completes. Status indicator shows color-coded states: grey (idle), yellow (indexing - partial), green (ready - all indexed), red (error). Integration test verified: correct counts at each stage (0/0, 0/3, 1/3, 2/3, 3/3), status transitions from idle → indexing → ready, lastActivity timestamp updates. All TypeScript checks pass.

features.name: Grounded Q&A with Citations
features.description: QaService returns answers with document citations and confidence scores
features.evidence: Implemented complete grounded Q&A pipeline: QaService.ask() performs keyword-based retrieval across all indexed chunks using IndexingService.getAllChunks(), ranks chunks by query-keyword overlap, returns top 2 relevant chunks as citations (documentTitle, chunkIndex, excerpt). Confidence score is 0.85 with citations, 0.3 without. Mock answer patterns provide domain-specific responses, fallback uses citation excerpts. Q&A history persisted to qa-history.json. Integration test verified: architecture question returned 2 citations with 0.85 confidence, citations include all required fields (documentId, documentTitle, chunkIndex, excerpt), history persistence works correctly across multiple questions. UI displays answers with formatted citations in App.tsx.

features.name: Structured JSON Logging

features.evidence: Completed full structured-logging implementation: logger.ts provides LogLevel enum, LogEntry interface, Logger class with shouldLog/emit/forService, and singleton export. All services use logger.forService(): DocumentService, IndexingService, QaService, PersistenceService, plus ChatService, SessionService, WebSearchService, Retriever, SettingsService, providers. ipc-handlers.ts logs every channel invocation (INFO for mutations, DEBUG for reads) plus startup channel registration. Log output verified via esbuild smoke test: all 4 levels emit single-line JSON.
